notes.title: Fear the Dark Unknown Chloe releases with a 30% launch sale!
notes.content:
Now you can experience the [b]Fear the Dark Unknown[/b] experience at lowest price.

Enjoy the complete adventure of Chloe Sullivan, entering to the Beresford mansion with the objective of saving her father.

But this mansion is not what it seems, and inside you will discover to what madness and despair can upset even the most sane person. [b]Fear [/b]and [b]suffering [/b]are the only way.

All paths lead to the same place. That dark and deep place where the [b]Dark Unknown awaits you[/b].
